# SCIRP (Scientific Research Publishing)

> > SCIRP is a multidisciplinary open access publisher hosting 200+ peer-reviewed journals across science, technology, medicine, and engineering with free manuscript submission and global researcher collaboration.

SCIRP provides a comprehensive platform for academic publishing, featuring open access journals, book publishing, peer-review resources, and author services across biomedical sciences, business, chemistry, computer science, engineering, and environmental sciences. The platform emphasizes transparent peer-review processes and accessible scientific research.

## Key Topics

- Open Access Publishing
- Peer-Review Process

## Core Platform & Navigation

- [SCIRP Open Access Homepage](https://www.scirp.org): SCIRP root homepage: 200+ open access journals in science, technology, medicine
- [Open Access Journals](https://www.scirp.org/journal/openaccess): Main open access journal platform with paper submission and peer-review
- [Journals by Subject](https://www.scirp.org/journal): Journal directory organized by subject categories with peer-review resources
- [Journals by Title](https://www.scirp.org/journal/indexbytitle): Journal directory indexed by title across biomedical, business, chemistry categories
- [Articles Directory](https://www.scirp.org/journal/articles): Article directory and browse interface for SCIRP's open access publications
- [Journal Articles Repository](https://www.scirp.org/journal/journalarticles): Journal articles repository with free download and peer-review access
- [Recently Published Papers](https://www.scirp.org/journal/recentlypublishedpapers): Recently published papers and open access articles from SCIRP journals

## Journal Collections & Archives

- [Biomedical & Life Sciences Journals](https://www.scirp.org/journal/categoryofjournal): Biomedical and life sciences journal category with open access publications
- [Journal Archives](https://www.scirp.org/journal/home): Journal archive with impact factor, ISSN, and article submission management
- [Special Issues](https://www.scirp.org/specialissues/specialissueslist): Special issues directory for SCIRP's multidisciplinary research journals
- [Paper Information](https://www.scirp.org/journal/paperinformation): Paper information and details for open access academic publications

## Author Services & Guidelines

- [Author Services](https://www.scirp.org/author): Author services including manuscript submission and language editing
- [For Authors](https://www.scirp.org/aboutus/forauthors): Author guidelines for manuscript preparation and publication process
- [Peer-Review Resources](https://www.scirp.org/journal/peer-review): Peer-review process information and reviewer recruitment program
- [Publication Ethics](https://www.scirp.org/publicationethics.html): Publication ethics policies and editorial guidelines for SCIRP journals

## Books & Publishing

- [Books](https://www.scirp.org/book): SCIRP book publishing platform and academic books catalog

## About & Support

- [About SCIRP](https://www.scirp.org/aboutus): About SCIRP: publisher information and organizational overview
- [FAQ](https://www.scirp.org/aboutus/faq): FAQ covering journal submission, open access, and publisher information
- [News & Announcements](https://www.scirp.org/news): News and announcements about SCIRP journals and academic publishing
